title: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1990

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1990
ACT
I OF 1990
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis. III (16)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th February, 1990 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on 1st July, 1989.

An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis. III (16)/90, dated
15-2-1990.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th February, 1990 and assented to by the
Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 6 of Act III of 1975.--In the Balochistan
Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975, hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in subsection (2) of
section 6, for the words "two thousand rupees" the words "three
thousand rupees" shall be substituted.

[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 15th February, 1990]
No.PAB/Legis. III (16)/90, dated

4. Insertion of new section 7-A in Act III of 1975.--In the said
Act, after section 7, the following shall be inserted namely:--
"7-A
Telephone.--The Chief Minister and a Minister shall be entitled to telephone
facilities at office and residence at Government expense without ceiling both
for official and private purposes throughout the term of their office and for a
period of fifteen days, immediately thereafter. They will also be entitled to
free telephonic facility while on tour where such facility is available:'
